alerts.title: Tire Chain Restrictions in Effect Due to Snow and/or Ice On Roadways
alerts.description: Chain restrictions are in effect on some park roads. All vehicles must carry chains or cables in some areas, including 4WD and AWD vehicles. Install chains when required. For current road information, call (559) 565-3341, (press 1, then 1).

alerts.title: Highway 180 to Cedar Grove in Kings Canyon National Park Closed for Winter
alerts.description: Highway 180 is closed east of Hume Lake Road for the winter season. Cedar Grove is not accessible by vehicle. This section of road usually reopens in April.

alerts.title: Mineral King Road in Sequoia National Park Is Closed for the Season
alerts.description: The portion of Mineral King Road inside Sequoia National Park is closed for the winter season.

alerts.title: Some Trails Closed in the Grant Grove Area Due to Prescribed Burn Activity
alerts.description: Firefighters conducted a prescribed burn in the vicinity of Grant Grove and the General Grant Tree. Smoke and flame may be visible in the area. This is normal. Areas and trails in and around the prescribed burn are closed until they are determined to be safe. They will be reopened once they are cleared of hazards. Click "more" to view a map showing all trail and area closures.

alerts.title: Weekday Traffic Delays on Generals Highway North of Giant Forest
alerts.description: Due to removal of hazard trees along Generals Highway between Highway 180 and Giant Forest, there are traffic delays on weekdays from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Vehicles may experience delays of up to 30 minutes at each work site. There will not be delays on federal holidays.
